name: Backend service unavailable (SIT)
messageRegex: .*(Service Unavailable|currently unavailable|service DOWN|Transaction Declined|Service is down).*

name: Session / driver allocation
messageRegex: .*(SessionNotCreated|Could not start a new session|Unable to create a new remote session|new session could not be created).*

name: Session lost / timed out (infra)
messageRegex: .*(SESSION LOST|Unable to find the session info|session has quit|invalid session id|NoSuchSession|Session ID is null|session is either terminated or not started).*

name: Network / Appium server unreachable (infra)
messageRegex: .*(HttpConnectTimeoutException|HTTP connect timed out|Connection refused|Read timed out|UnreachableBrowserException|Failed to connect to|ConnectException|SocketTimeoutException|remote browser.*may have died).*

name: App crashed / not in foreground
messageRegex: .*(APP CRASH|NOT IN FOREGROUND|has crashed|not in foreground).*

name: Test data / provisioning (VPN / backend seed)
messageRegex: .*(provision.*(fail|could not)|Failed to provision|check VPN|simulator seeding|Seed FAILED|Yakeen|pre-provisioned|no wallet balance|not funded|not a linked child).*

name: Card issuance / setup not completed
messageRegex: .*(Card issuance did not complete|Card setup navigation failed|card issuance|issuance did not|ATM toggle not available).*

name: Login screen not reached (app / session not ready)
Dashboard not reached after login
messageRegex: .*(Dashboard should be visible|did not reach dashboard|dashboard .*not .*visible|not reach the dashboard).*

name: Element not found / timeout
messageRegex: .*(TimeoutException|NoSuchElement|waiting for element|Expected condition failed|could not be located|StaleElementReference).*
